questions.question: Which department handles the Sensor Switch M558-2275045?
Please list all BOMs that include at least one part supplied by a Polish vendor.
Which bill of materials has the highest average unit cost for its hardware components, and what is that average?

prover.sparql:
SELECT * WHERE {
  ?bom pv:hasBomPart ?part .
  ?part pv:hasSupplier ?supplier .
  ?part pv:quantity ?quantity .
  ?part pv:hasPart ?hardware .
  ?hardware pv:price ?price .
}

uniqgen.sparql:
SELECT DISTINCT ?averageCost WHERE {
  ?bom rdf:type pv:BillOfMaterial .
  ?bom pv:hasBomPart ?bomPart .
  ?bomPart rdf:type pv:BomPart .
  ?bomPart pv:hasPart ?hardware .
  ?hardware rdf:type pv:Hardware .
  ?bomPart pv:quantity ?quantity .
  ?bomPart pv:price ?price .
  ?price pv:currency ?currency .
  ?price pv:amount ?amount .
  BIND((?amount / ?quantity) AS ?unitCost) .
  BIND(AVG(?unitCost) AS ?averageCost) .
}
